sources.title: Grok 4.20 0309 Non Reasoning
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP 200 exact model page and its public embedded model record identify grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, 1,000,000 context, TEXT/IMAGE inputs, TEXT output, functionCalling and structuredOutputs. The Reasoning tile is disabled (opacity-25); unlike the reasoning variant, this exact payload has no reasoning capability flag. It maps the beta-0309-non-reasoning identifier and other beta aliases to this ID. An internal algorithm label is not a network architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Release notes: Grok 4.20 and Grok 4.20 Multi-agent are live
sources.evidence: The original HTML places the Grok 4.20 API launch entry under March 10, 2026. The markdown representation drops individual dates, so the date was checked in the HTML. No March 9 launch entry is present.

sources.title: Responses API reference
sources.evidence: The documented non-reasoning example requests grok-4.20-beta-latest-non-reasoning and returns grok-4.20-beta-0309-non-reasoning with timestamp 2026-03-17 and zero reasoning tokens. This connects the historical beta snapshot to the current alias list; it is a documentation example, not an API call made in this audit.

sources.title: Grok 4.20 System Card, April 7, 2026
sources.evidence: Downloaded eight-page family card. Section 1.1 states text/image input and text output; app image generation and X video analysis are tool capabilities. Section 1.2 describes pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. The card evaluates single/multi-agent deployments but does not disclose total or active parameters or neural topology. It does not separately specify the 0309 non-reasoning checkpoint.

sources.title: Files
sources.evidence: Attaching documents automatically enables the attachment_search server-side tool. PDF support is document ingestion/search through that tool and does not establish PDF as a direct model modality.

sources.title: Enterprise Terms of Service, June 27, 2025
sources.evidence: Read the indexed primary text after direct HTTP access returned 403. Sections 1 and 4 describe limited access to hosted API services and retained ownership of underlying xAI technology. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification, not an open checkpoint license.

sources.title: xai-org published model inventory
sources.evidence: Direct complete response lists Grok 1 and Grok 2, with no Grok 4.20 weights. Together with hosted API documentation and proprietary terms, no public weights distribution for this exact snapshot was found.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 Model Card, July 20, 2026 revision
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-searched all 29 pages, including comparison tables, for Grok 4.20/4.2 and parameter/architecture terminology. No exact Grok 4.20 count or topology disclosure found; 4.2 matches are section numbering.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Model Card, August 17, 2026 revision
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-searched all 42 pages and comparison tables. No Grok 4.20 total/active count or architecture disclosure found; 4.2 matches are section numbers or benchmark values.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 Model Card, September 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-searched all 30 pages and comparison tables. No exact Grok 4.20 parameter or topology disclosure found. Targeted searches of x.ai for this model with training, interpretability, parameters and architecture found no further exact technical disclosure.

sources.title: Grok 4.20 Non-Reasoning About
sources.evidence: Provider documentation explicitly states that the non-reasoning variant was released March 10, 2026 and skips intermediate reasoning traces. Used to corroborate the xAI launch date and mode, not for neural specifications.

sources.title: Models.dev exact non-reasoning record
sources.evidence: Upstream baseline source is accessible. It supplies March 9, PDF input, and a generic description including reasoning, but no primary evidence for those assertions. Its context and non-reasoning capability agree with xAI documentation.

sources.title: Elon Musk: Grok 4.20 has 0.5T total parameters, April 9, 2026
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP 200 X syndication response identifies Elon Musk and preserves the parent question explicitly asking whether Grok 4.20 is 500B total or 500B active in a larger MoE. Musk answers 0.5T total. Canonical post: https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2042123561666855235. This establishes a rounded total, not active count or dense/MoE topology; it does not spell out the dated non-reasoning API ID.

sources.title: Elon Musk confirms Grok 4.2 is 0.5T, April 8, 2026
sources.evidence: Independently fetched direct HTTP 200 X syndication response: Musk confirms Grok 4.2 is 0.5T in reply to a post explicitly naming Grok 4.20 and 500 billion parameters. The April 7 system card likewise abbreviates Grok 4.20 as 4.2. Canonical post: https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2041893772683047215. No active-parameter or network-topology disclosure.

sources.title: xAI Grok 4.20 model modes
sources.evidence: Provider documentation describes Grok 4.20 as one model offered in two modes through separate API models, explicitly naming xai.grok-4.20-0309-reasoning and xai.grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning. Supports mapping the named non-reasoning variant to Grok 4.20, but supplies no independent tensor count or claim that checkpoint weights are identical.

name.note: Normalized display name for the exact dated non-reasoning API variant; no replacement model specifications used.

developer.note: xAI identifies itself as developer in the April 2026 system card.

family.note: Exact endpoint is part of the Grok family.

release_date.note: xAI dates the API launch March 10, independently corroborated for the non-reasoning mode by Vercel. The 0309 suffix alone does not establish a March 9 public release. Earlier consumer-family availability and the currently redirected 0304 beta alias do not date this exact 0309 snapshot; April card publication and later provider listings are not its first release.

open_weights.note: This exact model is documented as a proprietary hosted API model; no publicly distributed weights were found in the official organization inventory. Grok 1/2 releases do not establish Grok 4.20 openness.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted access under xAI terms; no named open-weight license for this snapshot.

parameters_b.note: Nominal approximately 500 billion total parameters: xAI founder Musk directly confirms 0.5T total for Grok 4.20, distinguishing total from active. The exact xAI page identifies this endpoint as Grok 4.20, and Oracle documents the dated non-reasoning and reasoning identifiers as its two modes. Applied as the disclosed Grok 4.20 model size for the non-reasoning mode, not a separately counted 0309 checkpoint: the posts do not enumerate API suffixes, specify tensor-exact precision, or establish identical weights across modes. This uses a direct statement about Grok 4.20, not a transfer from Grok 4.3.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count per token is reported for this mode in accessed original/later documentation. Musk explicitly identifies 0.5T as total in response to a total-versus-active question; this does not reveal active parameters or justify equating the two.

architecture.note: Training stages are disclosed but neural structure, Transformer topology and dense/MoE classification are not established for this exact variant. Musk clarifies total versus active size without resolving topology: 500B total does not imply a dense model. Later-card comparisons and targeted first-party training/interpretability searches yielded no exact network disclosure. Single-agent/non-reasoning modes and an internal serving algorithm label are not architectures.

context_window.note: Exact xAI endpoint page and embedded model record specify 1,000,000. This is the documented native endpoint limit; no authenticated operation test or sibling/provider limit is asserted.

modalities.note: Exact endpoint declares text/image input and text output. Remove PDF as a direct modality: file attachment_search supplies document content through tools. App image generation and X video analysis likewise do not add native output/input modalities.

reasoning.note: The exact non-reasoning page displays its Reasoning tile disabled and its feature payload omits reasoning, unlike the separate reasoning endpoint. The dated beta API example reports zero reasoning tokens. Flattened page text misleadingly retains the disabled generic tile description; the underlying page state resolves the apparent conflict.

tool_call.note: The exact payload explicitly sets functionCalling true, corroborating the displayed enabled function-calling capability.

description.value: Non-reasoning Grok 4.20 model with text and image input, text output, function calling, and a 1 million token context window.
description.note: Replaces a generic family description claiming reasoning with the exact variant capabilities; omits unverified comparative marketing claims.

patch.description: Non-reasoning Grok 4.20 model with text and image input, text output, function calling, and a 1 million token context window.

sources.label: Release notes: Grok 4.20 and Grok 4.20 Multi-agent are live
Elon Musk: Grok 4.20 has 0.5T total parameters, April 9, 2026
Elon Musk confirms Grok 4.2 is 0.5T, April 8, 2026

patch.notes: The 0309 identifier is not evidence of a March 9 public release: xAI dates the API launch March 10, 2026. Approximately 500B total parameters is the nominal Grok 4.20 size directly confirmed by Elon Musk in April 2026, applied to its documented non-reasoning mode; the posts do not provide a separate tensor count for the dated API snapshot. Active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed. PDF attachments use server-side search, not a direct model modality.

summary: Correct release date to March 10, 2026, classify licensing as proprietary, remove tool-mediated PDF input, and replace the generic reasoning description. Record nominal 500B total from direct founder posts explicitly naming Grok 4.20 and distinguishing total from active; exact endpoint/mode linkage and count granularity are qualified. Confirm 1M context, non-reasoning mode and function calling. All 14 fields assessed; active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed after original/later cards and founder statements. No Grok 4.3 size or earlier-family release date is transferred.
